hero.lede: Tell Paperwork Pilot what has happened. It lists every form, document, office, fee and wait in the order that works, so step 5 never needs something from step 8.

how.title: Every step knows what it needs from the others.
how.body: Official information exists, but it sits on dozens of sites and never tells you the sequence. Paperwork Pilot stores each step as a link in a chain, so the order is worked out for you.

graph.aria: Four steps in a row: register the death, certified copies, legal heir certificate, bank claim. The bank claim also needs the certified copies directly, so it waits for both.

order.title: The order holds up
order.body: Each step lists what it needs and what it produces. The bank claim waits for both the certified copies and the legal heir certificate, so you never queue for it too early.

docs.title: One document list for the whole route
docs.body: Whatever one step produces is ticked for you when you finish it. What is left is what you still have to collect.

deadlines.label: DAYS LEFT
deadlines.title: Deadlines that count down
deadlines.body: A death is registered within 21 days. Paperwork Pilot counts from the date of the event and reminds you before the window closes.

tipsCard.aria: Sample tips from people who visited the office

tips.text: Bring one self-attested photocopy with the original. This counter keeps the copy.
Go after 2 pm. The morning token queue is the longest.
Ask for the acknowledgement slip before you leave. You need it to track the file.

tipsCard.title: Tips from people who stood in that queue
tipsCard.body: Short notes per office, moderated and dated, and easy to flag when they go stale.

pros.title: Every client's paperwork on one screen.
pros.body: Chartered accountants, lawyers and HR teams repeat the same routes every week. The Pro plan tracks each client against the route, flags missing documents and keeps fees and forms current so you do not have to.

roles.what: Run succession, registration and licensing cases with a shareable checklist per client.
Move people into a new city with the same route every time.
Offer the route to customers going through a bereavement.
